title: Behavioral Compositionality of Sparse Autoencoder Representations
abstract: arXiv:2610.21261v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) represent model activations with sparse, linearly decoded features, but the downstream effects of those features need not compose additively. We introduce SAE Additivity Residuals (SAR), which measure the behavioral variation left unexplained above a chosen interaction order. Under independent feature subset sampling, population SAR is exactly the normalized energy of interactions above that order and bounds coalition ordering error for the optimal low order approximation. To distinguish compositionality associated with the SAE representation from that induced by downstream computation, we compare learned SAE coordinates with sum preserving random rotations of the same selected subspace and find lower first order residuals for the learned coordinates across all 18 model and behavior settings. translated_title: 稀疏自编码器表示的行为组合性
translated_abstract: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）使用稀疏的、线性解码的特征来表示模型激活，但这些特征的下游效应不一定是按加法方式组合的。我们引入了SAE可加性残差（SAR），用于衡量在选定交互阶数以上未能被解释的行为变异。在独立特征子集采样的条件下，总体SAR恰好等于该阶数以上交互的归一化能量，并为最优低阶近似的联盟排序误差提供了上界。为了区分与SAE表示本身相关的组合性与由下游计算所诱导的组合性，我们将学习到的SAE坐标与同一所选子空间的保和随机旋转进行比较，发现在所有18个模型和行为设置中，学习到的坐标都具有更低的一阶残差。然而，这些坐标并非完全可加：在每一设置中，成对交互项均能改善留出集上的联盟排序。
tldr: 论文提出SAE可加性残差（SAR）来度量稀疏自编码器特征在行为层面的组合性，发现学习到的SAE坐标比随机旋转具有更强的一阶可加性，但仍存在不可忽略的高阶交互项。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces SAE Additivity Residuals (SAR) to measure the behavioral compositionality of sparse autoencoder features, showing that learned SAE coordinates exhibit lower first-order residuals than random rotations yet are not fully additive.
